verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that existing fields, pipeline stages, views, and automations can be modified, and that contacts, companies, and deals can be merged. Nothing documents creating new custom object types or defining relationships between objects. Customizing fields on built-in records is an adjacent feature, not custom object modeling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals
